gloss: to spend, to devote (time, money, effort)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {費|つい}やしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to spend, to devote, to expend
definitions.explanation: To use time, money, or effort for a purpose. Often implies a significant or substantial amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{費|つい}やす。
⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{費|つい}やした。
examples.english: I devoted many years to research.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{莫大|ばくだい}→莫大：03700_bakudai⟧な⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{費|つい}やした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{期待|きたい}した→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{得|え}られなかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: We spent an enormous amount of money on this project, but didn't get the expected results.

notes:
{費|つい}やす implies spending a significant or noteworthy amount.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧…⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{費|つい}やす (to spend ... on ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{費|つい}やす: to spend time
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{費|つい}やす: to spend money
- ⟦{労力|ろうりょく}→労力：22670_rouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{費|つい}やす: to expend effort
- ⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{費|つい}やす: to spend years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {費|つい}やす: to spend/devote (implies significance, often written style)
- ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use, to spend (general, everyday)
- かける: to spend (time/money, neutral)
